items.name: IAM identities/service accounts/scopes
items.reason: IAM metadata/reference foundations already exist and are the canonical owner for agent/service-account identity and scopes. No parallel identity engine is justified.

items.name: Vault / secret handling
items.reason: CEREBRO already uses secret references and forbids secret values in general registries. The remaining gap is physical binding to authorized secret stores/providers where required; no new paid vault is justified by default.

items.name: Standing permissions
items.reason: Company/environment/consumer-scoped fail-closed policies already provide standing authorization boundaries for ordinary work.

items.name: Auto-renew session/token
items.reason: Lifecycle health, expiry metadata and consumer-local holds exist. Physical provider-specific renewals remain subject to each provider's supported flow and real credentials.

items.name: Tool routing API→MCP→script→browser
items.reason: The canonical execution ladder already prefers official API, authorized MCP, local script and only then browser/computer-use fallback.

items.name: Browser Bridge existente
items.reason: The bridge contract exists and should be preserved/wrapped, not replaced. A fresh real device/session binding is still required at execution time before claiming physical operation.

items.name: GenericAgent
items.reason: MIT benchmark/pattern source only. External code execution remains disabled and no new runtime is justified.

items.name: Camoufox
items.reason: Compatibility research may be useful, but anti-abuse/CAPTCHA/MFA evasion is forbidden. No runtime activation is justified without a concrete authorized use case that preserves platform controls.

items.name: NeuralAgent patterns
items.reason: Watch/Learn/Replay design patterns are useful reference material; no external runtime dependency is required.

items.name: Watch & Learn / deterministic replay
items.reason: The demonstrate→verify→freeze→replay policy is defined but not evidenced as a complete physical capability. This is a real zero-cost gap to extend existing LRN/QA/AUTO through FACT-001, not a new engine.

items.name: CEREBRO Android Device Worker
items.reason: The logical device route exists, but no real Android worker is deployed. Build as a reusable capability/app bound to existing engines; do not create a new server/engine by default.

items.name: Jarvis OSS Android
items.reason: Useful benchmark for the Android worker only. Do not add a second Android runtime or dependency before the native CEREBRO worker gap is built and measured.

items.name: ArCHer benchmark
items.reason: Research benchmark only; not a production dependency and not a reason to create another engine.
